entries.sense_en: minor bad behavior or rule-breaking, not a serious crime

synonyms.nuance: More general and can be serious; often means breaking a law or rule.
Everyday word for a child's or worker's bad conduct; less formal than misdemeanour.
Literary; suggests a morally wrong act, not just breaking a rule.

entries.tip_ko: 법률 용어로는 '경범죄'라는 뜻도 있다. 미국식 철자는 misdemeanor.

entries.sense_en: smooth, polite and confident in manner, sometimes in an insincere way

synonyms.nuance: Informal; charming and slick, often suggesting the person is a little too clever.
Refined and well trained in manners, with no hint of insincerity.
Literary; cheerful, elegant and charming, usually of a man.

entries.tip_ko: 발음은 '스웨이브'가 아니라 /swɑv/ '스와브'.

entries.sense_en: used as 'a trifle': slightly, a little

synonyms.nuance: Neutral, common; works with any adjective or verb.
Casual spoken English; a trifle sounds old-fashioned and formal.
Formal; a moderate degree, often with a negative shade.

entries.sense_en: with threads coming loose at the edge because of wear

synonyms.nuance: General; thin or damaged from long use, not necessarily with loose threads.
Cloth worn so thin the threads show; suggests poverty or age.
Torn in many places; more damaged than frayed.

entries.sense_en: a man who cares too much about looking elegant and fashionable

synonyms.nuance: Insulting; vain and silly about clothes.
Modern, friendly; simply someone who dresses sharply.
Figurative; a man who shows off in bright clothes.

entries.sense_en: feeling and showing sorrow for having done wrong

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and mild; it need not involve guilt.
Stresses deep, lasting guilt over a serious wrong.
Formal or religious; includes a wish to change one's ways.

entries.sense_en: deep, long-lasting bitter anger toward someone

synonyms.nuance: Anger over unfair treatment; can be quiet and not as bitter as rancour.
Everyday word for lasting hurt anger, often after disappointment.
A wish to hurt someone, more active than rancour.

entries.tip_ko: 미국식 철자는 rancor.

entries.sense_en: showed clearly (a feeling or quality)

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday word; evince is formal and used for feelings or qualities.
To put on view, often on purpose.
To uncover something that was hidden.

entries.sense_en: rude behavior that does not show proper respect, especially toward elders or superiors

synonyms.nuance: British informal; bold talk that is annoying rather than serious.
Stronger; open, scornful disrespect toward authority.
The everyday word; any impolite behavior to anyone.

entries.tip_ko: im-(부정) + pertinent(적절한). 본래 '적절치 않음'에서 '주제넘음, 무례함'으로 뜻이 옮겨 갔다.

entries.sense_en: a strong dislike that makes you want to avoid someone or something

synonyms.nuance: Mild and general; no strong urge to avoid.
A sick, physical feeling of strong disapproval.
Sudden, intense disgust that makes you pull back.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 aversion to + 대상 형태로 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: in a way that treats serious things without proper respect
entries.sense_ko: 진지함 없이 건방지게, 불손할 만큼 가볍게

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; relaxed, not necessarily disrespectful.
Joking at a serious moment, on purpose.
Smooth and too easy, suggesting little thought or sincerity.

entries.sense_en: a long, painful or frightening experience that is hard to endure

synonyms.nuance: A test of patience or strength; can be milder and less frightening.
Lasting difficulty such as poverty; not a single event.
Informal, figurative; an experience so awful it seems unreal.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 두 번째 음절 (ɔrˈdil).

entries.sense_en: rude, scornful behavior toward someone in authority

synonyms.nuance: Bold and shameless rudeness, often from someone younger or lower in rank.
Feeling superior to others; not necessarily aimed at authority.
The plain, neutral word for lack of respect.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 첫 음절 IN-so-lence.

entries.sense_en: wanting to hurt someone as revenge for a wrong

synonyms.nuance: Petty wish to hurt others, not necessarily as revenge.
Seeking revenge, often more serious and planned.
Wanting to cause harm for its own sake, with no need for a past wrong.

entries.sense_en: cornered by pursuers with no way out, forced to turn and face them

synonyms.nuance: Common; trapped with no way to escape.
Being chased; not yet trapped.
Literary hunting phrase: the hunted animal turns to face its pursuers.

entries.tip_ko: 이 bay는 '만(灣)'이 아니라 사냥개가 짖는 소리에서 온 말로, 짖어 대는 개들에게 둘러싸여 몰린 상태를 뜻한다.

entries.sense_en: made him feel very happy, excited and full of energy

synonyms.nuance: A sudden burst of excitement, often from something fast or risky.
Gives pleasure; calmer than exhilarate.
Gives physical or mental energy, like fresh air or exercise.

entries.tip_ko: h는 발음하지 않는다: /ɪɡˈzɪl-/.

entries.sense_en: so excited or upset that he could not control himself

synonyms.nuance: Formal; very nervous and upset, usually unhappy.
Informal; upset or excited, but less extreme.
Wildly hurried because of fear or worry.

entries.tip_ko: beside oneself with joy/anger/grief처럼 뒤에 with 감정을 붙인다.

entries.sense_en: full of lively, cheerful energy

synonyms.nuance: General; active and full of life.
Informal; cheerful and talkative.
Bright and witty in conversation.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 사람(특히 여성)의 성격을 칭찬할 때 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: a proud, cold manner that shows you think you are better than others

synonyms.nuance: The plain English form of the same idea.
Overrating oneself in any way; not always cold or distant.
Looking down on people of lower class or taste.

entries.tip_ko: 프랑스어에서 온 말로 강세는 뒤 음절에 있다. h를 빼고 /oʊˈtɝ/로 발음하기도 한다.

entries.sense_en: to relax and stop being tense or excited

synonyms.nuance: Most common way to say relax after stress or work.
General and neutral.
Stop being angry, upset or excited.

entries.tip_ko: '실망시키다'라는 let someone down과 다른 뜻이다.

entries.sense_en: stayed near a place with no real purpose, often just watching

synonyms.nuance: Suggests staying somewhere without a good reason; may sound suspicious.
Staying a little longer than needed, often from reluctance to leave.
Same meaning; slightly more common in American English.

entries.sense_en: keen, lively enjoyment and excitement

synonyms.nuance: Eager interest in something; can be calm.
Energetic enjoyment, especially in doing or eating something.
Deep pleasure in something, often a taste or an experience.

entries.tip_ko: zest for life는 '삶에 대한 열정'.

entries.sense_en: a small jeweled crown worn by women on formal occasions

synonyms.nuance: Bigger, worn by a king or queen as a symbol of power.
Literary; a jeweled headband or crown.
A small crown worn by nobles, not a monarch.

entries.sense_en: great force or violent strength

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for physical strength.
Wild anger, or a violent storm.
Strength of feeling or effect; not necessarily violent.

entries.tip_ko: h는 소리 나지 않는다: /ˈviə-/.

entries.sense_en: very strong dislike and disgust

synonyms.nuance: Strong hostility, often toward a person.
Sick feeling caused by something unpleasant to see or smell.
Formal and rare; deep and lasting hatred.

entries.tip_ko: 동사 loathe /loʊð/는 th가 유성음이다. 형용사 loath /loʊθ/(꺼리는)와 혼동하지 말 것.

entries.sense_en: a time of wild, excessive pleasure, such as heavy drinking

synonyms.nuance: Informal; a short period of doing too much of something.
Wild party, often sexual; can also mean any excess.
A lively, careless burst of an activity, less morally serious.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 두 번째 음절, /dɪˈbɔtʃ/.

entries.sense_en: approached and spoken to, often in an unwelcome way

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; simply come near and speak.
Face someone directly, often about a problem.
Informal; catch someone to talk at length.

entries.sense_en: good judgment and wisdom, especially in practical matters

synonyms.nuance: Deep knowledge and experience of life.
Sharp practical judgment, especially about money or people.
The ability to see the true nature of a thing.

entries.tip_ko: 형용사는 sagacious. sage와 같은 어원.

entries.sense_en: natural tendencies or habits, especially ones that are not admirable

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for a likely way of behaving.
A mild leaning toward something.
Formal; a strong natural tendency, often toward something bad.

entries.sense_en: wild, reckless behavior of young people before they settle down

synonyms.nuance: A short period of wild pleasure or a brief love affair.
The full idiom; often used of young men before marriage.
synonyms.example: he sowed his wild oats in his twenties

synonyms.nuance: Polite and slightly humorous; one foolish act excused by youth, not a whole wild period.

entries.tip_ko: '야생 귀리'가 아니라 젊은 날의 방탕을 뜻하는 관용구.

entries.sense_en: finishing or getting done (work) quickly and easily

synonyms.nuance: Neutral, no sense of speed.
Write or produce something fast and carelessly.
Finish something quickly, often food or a task.

entries.tip_ko: knock off (work)는 '퇴근하다'라는 뜻으로도 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: a heavy, dull, sleepy lack of energy

synonyms.nuance: Slow, heavy movement or thought; less formal.
Lack of interest or feeling, more about emotion than energy.
Tiredness from effort; lethargy suggests a dull mood too.

entries.tip_ko: g는 /dʒ/로 발음한다.

entries.sense_en: similar in nature or kind (to something)

synonyms.nuance: The common everyday word; akin is more formal and suggests sharing the same nature.
Connected by origin or family.
Close enough to be compared fairly.

entries.tip_ko: akin to 형태로 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: visit informally without a planned appointment

synonyms.nuance: American everyday; a short casual visit.
British; a short visit, often on the way somewhere.
General; might be planned and longer.

entries.tip_ko: drop in on + 사람 / drop in at + 장소.

entries.sense_en: the power to attract and tempt

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; something that draws people.
Attraction toward something wrong or unwise.
Exciting, glittering charm connected with fame or wealth.

entries.sense_en: outward appearance or form, often hiding the true nature

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; how something looks.
Deliberate change so as not to be recognized.
A false or partial likeness of something.

entries.tip_ko: in the guise of ~ : '~의 모습으로'.

entries.sense_en: crudely showy and sensational, in bad taste

synonyms.nuance: Cheaply bright and flashy; nearly the same, a little more common.
Informal; made to attract attention, often expensive-looking.
Judges taste directly; can also refer to jokes or behavior.

entries.tip_ko: 보통은 색이나 빛이 '지나치게 화려한'이라는 뜻. 여기서는 소설이 선정적이고 자극적이라는 비유로 쓰였다.

entries.sense_en: having a strong wish to become an actor

synonyms.nuance: Dreamy and unrealistic about fame or love.
Overwhelmed by meeting a famous person.
Neutral; hoping to become something, like an aspiring actor.

entries.tip_ko: stage에 '홀린(struck)' 상태.

entries.sense_en: a show of boldness or confidence that hides fear or weakness

synonyms.nuance: Proud, showy way of walking or acting.
Loud, empty talk, usually when angry or nervous.
Real bravery; bravado is only for show.

entries.tip_ko: 긍정적인 '용기'가 아니라 '허세'.

entries.sense_en: met and began to spend time with someone

synonyms.nuance: Begin a friendship, often with someone unsuitable.
synonyms.example: took up with a bad crowd

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; no sense of joining company.
Deliberately become part of a group.

entries.tip_ko: fall in with a bad crowd는 '불량한 무리와 어울리다'.

entries.sense_en: for the present time only

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; for the time being.
Neutral and common; not permanent.
Slightly formal; until things change.
synonyms.example: stay here for the time being

entries.sense_en: untidy and dirty in dress and appearance (of a woman)

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; messy.
Careless in dress or work.
Hair or clothes not combed or cared for.

entries.tip_ko: -ly로 끝나지만 형용사다.

entries.sense_en: in a way that seems believable, whether or not it is true

synonyms.nuance: Makes the listener actually believe; stronger.
Plain word; hard to doubt.
Suggests a trustworthy source or reason.

entries.tip_ko: '그럴듯하지만 사실은 거짓'일 수 있다는 뉘앙스가 있다.

entries.sense_en: looking splendid and dazzling, especially in fine clothes

synonyms.nuance: Very fine and impressive; less about shining.
Giving off light; often used of a happy face.
Informal; very beautiful.

entries.tip_ko: resplendent in + 옷차림 형태로 자주 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: quiet thinking about things that happened in the past

synonyms.nuance: Careful thought, about the past or the present.
Fond, often spoken memory of the past.
Understanding events only after they happened.

entries.sense_en: openly challenged someone or something to a fight

synonyms.nuance: General; ask someone to compete or prove something.
Openly refuse to obey or accept.
The opposite: to accept a challenge.

entries.tip_ko: gauntlet은 중세 기사의 갑옷 장갑. 이것을 땅에 던지는 것이 결투 신청이었다.

entries.sense_en: doing his dull daily work unwillingly and resentfully, like a harnessed horse that will not pull

synonyms.nuance: Doing one's regular work, without the idea of being unhappy.
synonyms.example: back in harness after the holiday

synonyms.nuance: Working hard for a long time.
Informal; working very hard as if forced.

entries.tip_ko: traces는 말과 수레를 잇는 봇줄. kick over the traces는 '굴레를 벗어던지고 제멋대로 굴다'.

entries.sense_en: a false reason given to hide the real one

synonyms.nuance: General reason for a fault or absence; may be true.
Acting as if something were true.
A prepared false explanation.
synonyms.example: a cover story for his trip

entries.tip_ko: on/under the pretext of ~ : '~을 구실로'.

entries.sense_en: unlimited power over everything

synonyms.nuance: Highest position above all others.
Control or greater influence than others.
Rare; religious sense of God's power.

entries.tip_ko: 원래 신의 속성(omni-=모든, potent=힘)이라 '부(富)의 전능함'은 과장된 표현.

entries.sense_en: in a quiet, thoughtful way, often a little sadly

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; showing careful thought.
Sadly longing for something you cannot have.
Absent-minded, as in a dream.

entries.sense_en: embarrassed and uneasy in front of others

synonyms.nuance: Common; awkward from social discomfort.
Feeling guilt or shame about something wrong.
Slightly embarrassed after doing something foolish.

entries.tip_ko: 반대말 unabashed(거리낌 없는, 뻔뻔한)가 더 자주 쓰인다.

entries.sense_en: to guess about something without full evidence

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; may be a quick guess with no thought.

Formal; infer from small signs.

entries.sense_en: to wear clothes that suit the role you want to play

synonyms.nuance: Appear right for a role; not only clothes.
Act out a role.

synonyms.nuance: Wear special or formal clothes.

Sadness about any past action; not always a wrong.
Formal, religious; sorrow with a wish to make amends.

entries.tip_ko: remorse는 '죄책감을 동반한 후회'이고 regret은 더 넓은 말.

entries.sense_en: made full use of a story for news, telling every detail

synonyms.nuance: Make widely known.
Make a story more shocking than it is.
Use a situation for gain.

Without real effort or enthusiasm.

entries.sense_en: brave and ready to face danger or difficulty to the end

synonyms.nuance: Brave in a small, cheerful way.
Lively and determined.
Ready to do it; no sense of courage.

entries.tip_ko: '게임'이 아니라 형용사: be game (for ~) = 기꺼이 도전하다.

entries.sense_en: very dry and thirsty

synonyms.nuance: General, not extreme.
Wanting a drink; describes the person, not the mouth.
Land with almost no rain.

entries.sense_en: moving with difficulty and clumsiness, as through deep snow

synonyms.nuance: General effort against difficulty.
Trip or walk unsteadily.
Walk through water or something thick, but more steadily.

entries.tip_ko: flounder(허우적대다)와 founder(침몰하다)를 혼동하지 말 것.

entries.sense_en: moral lectures or dull advice about how to behave

synonyms.nuance: A religious talk, or any long moral lecture.
A tired, obvious remark said as if it were wise.
